description: This file defines models and database views related to account analytic lines and timesheet invoice reports in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including class definitions, fields, methods, and SQL view initialization.

classes.name: account_analytic_line
classes.description: Model representing analytic accounting lines with fields, search, validation, and view header methods.

classes.name: timesheet_invoice
classes.description: Model representing a database view for timesheet invoice reports, aggregating analytic line data.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Overrides the search method to filter by date range if specified in context.

methods.name: _check_company
methods.description: Validates that the analytic line's account and move line belong to the same company.

methods.name: on_change_unit_amount
methods.description: Calculates amount and sets general account based on product and unit amount.

methods.name: view_header_get
methods.description: Generates header text for the view based on the analytic account name.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates or replaces the SQL view for the timesheet invoice report.
